about.value: Redneck Riviera Nashville is a unique, 8,000 square foot live-music venue in the heart of lower Broadway created by John Rich built to celebrate a state of mind. It serves as a nostalgic destination bringing people together while paying tribute to the men and women that work hard so that we can celebrate freely.
